arabic text: Utray The Iss Zameen Par Arsh-e-Bareen Ke Tare.
english translation text: O moon of Karbala, you must have seen the stars of the highest Throne descend upon this earth.

arabic text: Aye Chand Jalwa Gar Hai Hashim Ka Chan Yaan Par.\nKhairat Roshni Ki Le Lijiyo Yaan Se.
english translation text: O moon, the moon of Hashim shines here;\ntake the charity of light from this place.

arabic text: Aye Chand Iss Zameen Par Rakhiyon Hamesha Thandak.\nSote Hain Jo Yahan Pe Zahra(SA) Ke Woh Hain Pyare.
english translation text: O moon, always keep this land cool;\nthose sleeping here are Zahra's beloved ones.

arabic text: Tasneem-o-Salsabeel-o-Kausar Ke Hain Yeh Malik.\nMarey Gaye Jo Pyase Iss Nehar Ke Kinare.
english translation text: They are the masters of Tasneem, Salsabeel and Kawthar,\nyet they were killed thirsty beside this river.

arabic text: Bazu Katay Yahin Par Abbas-e-Bawafa Ke.\nIzn-e-Wiga Na Paya Pani Bhi La Na Paye.
english translation text: Here the arms of faithful Abbas were severed;\nhe received no permission for battle and could not bring back water.

arabic text: Shehzada-e-Jina Hi Malik Hai Karbala Ka.\nKis Ki Majal Aaye Jab Tak Na Woh Bulaye.
english translation text: The prince of the garden is the master of Karbala;\nwho can arrive unless he himself calls them?

arabic text: Pohanche Hain Karbala Mein Jo Loag:SIBT-E-JAFAR:.\nAye Kash Phir Muqadar Inn Ko Yeh Din Dikhaye.
english translation text: O Sibt-e-Jafar, those who have reached Karbala—\nmay destiny show them this day once again.
